channel.title: Claude News
channel.description: News, announcements, and stories from Anthropic about Claude and the people building with it.

item.title: How an Anthropic BDR in Japan runs his day with Claude Managed Agents
item.description: How one business development representative clears his inbound queue and drafts bilingual customer emails with Claude Managed Agents and Claude Tag.

item.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
item.description: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.

item.title: Claude Security now scans continuously and tracks fixes
item.description: Claude Security now keeps up with your repositories as code changes, tracks findings until they’re fixed, learns from the context your team adds, and connects to your tools through an API and MCP. Available in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers.

item.title: Introducing Claude Duet
item.description: A research preview is available by waitlist today, starting with US Pro and Max subscribers.

item.title: HCLTech joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
item.description: HCLTech will bring Claude into the solutions it provides for banks, hospitals, telecom companies, and manufacturers.

item.title: The full Claude Platform, available on Google Cloud
item.description: Use Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) to access Claude Platform features with Google Cloud authentication, billing, and commitment retirement.

item.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
item.description: We need ways to prove that code is free of bugs. Formal software verification could provide this guarantee.

item.title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop
item.description: When building agents in Claude Platform, using fewer subagents in favor of progressively disclosed context and tools can improve quality while reducing cost and latency. Here’s when and how to migrate.

item.title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
item.description: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.

item.title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
item.description: Our new Claude for Nonprofits plugin brings new skills to every verified nonprofit organization, taking on the operational work that stretches small teams across fundraising, marketing, and hiring.
